TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd will field a dedicated multidisciplinary delivery team for the twelve-hospital, 5 MW aggregate program, led by a PMP-certified Project Manager and supported by solar design engineers, electrical/civil supervisors, SCADA/monitoring specialists, and O&M technicians for the full three-year period. Our delivery capacity is backed by 250 staff, including six PMP-certified project managers and four PE-registered engineers, with offices in Islamabad (HQ), Lahore, and Karachi for responsive site coverage across Punjab. [CO-PROFILE]

Certifications and quality standards are embedded in our management system. We hold ISO 9001 for quality management and will execute all survey, engineering design, procurement, installation, testing, commissioning, training, and O&M activities under ISO 9001-controlled procedures, including document control, inspection and test plans, NCR/CAPA handling, and client acceptance sign-offs. [CO-PROFILE] Our prior provincial government delivery under ISO 9001 further evidences practical application of this QMS in live projects. [CAP-045]

For project governance, we maintain PMP-certified project managers as a standard staffing pool, aligning with your requirement for a certified PM and structured controls (schedule, risk, change, and stakeholder management). [CO-PROFILE] Our delivery discipline is reinforced by CMMI Level 3 process maturity, evidenced across multiple deployments, supporting repeatable execution across 12 sites with consistent reporting. [CO-PROFILE] [CAP-008]

For monitoring and cybersecurity of the central dashboard, we bring ISO 27001-certified capability evidenced on federal-government and network-design engagements. [CO-PROFILE] [CAP-020]

Where the RFP requires specific compliance evidence (e.g., IEC 62548 and Pakistan Electricity Code), our library does not yet evidence prior explicit certification/attestation to those codes; we will address this through code-compliance checklists, third-party electrical testing, and DISCO-facing documentation as part of the commissioning dossier. [CO-PROFILE]
